message:
fix(build): preserve published container provenance

Import the shared publisher metadata target and execute the approved
Builds publisher so both container architectures retain the exact source,
version and creation metadata. Declare the documented normal release
mode explicitly and keep corrective authority inputs absent.

Use the qualified Builds audit snapshot without changing package scope.
